players.label: Centre tiles
players.does: the tiles around the middle of the box, in turn

players.label: Latest MODIS
players.does: the tile with the strongest recent MODIS fire power

players.label: Least sure
players.does: the tile where the model is least sure

players.label: Most expected new detections
players.does: the tile where the model expects the most hidden detections its map does not already hold

players.label: Least sure, at night
players.does: the tile where the model is least sure, on night passes

players.label: Least sure, when most unsure
players.does: the tile where the model is least sure, in each stretch at the look where it is most unsure

players.label: Least sure, at a sharp pass
players.does: the tile where the model is least sure; one look in each stretch of the episode, at the first pass sharper than the passes seen so far in that stretch, by a bar that eases as the stretch runs out, and at the stretch's last pass if none is

players.label: Learned
players.does: the tile with the highest learned score

players.label: Learned, tiles only
players.does: the tile with the highest learned score, on the evenly spread looks

players.label: Sees the answer
players.does: reads the hidden data and takes the tile with the largest reward at each of the evenly spread looks; it chooses where, not when, so a player that also chooses when can gain more

ids: an id as listed; the constant tile is asked as constant_<tile>, a tile index; the oracle only with ceiling: true
